# Welcome, Microbial Superheroes {.unnumbered}

![](images/logo.svg){fig-alt="LSC 170 logo: a caped red microscope" width=180}

This interactive workbook accompanies **LSC 170: Microbial Superheroes**. Each module uses
the **C.R.E.A.T.E.** method to read and understand primary scientific literature,
with the bacterium *Delftia* as our running example.

::: {.callout-tip}
## How to use this book
Work through each module in order. Answer the self-check questions, expand the
hint boxes, and type your notes into the text boxes — they are saved in your browser.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
Adapted from *The Delftia Book* (NC State University Libraries, CC BY-NC 4.0).
for the authoritative text, figures, and readings.
:::
